blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Health (DOH) in Mimaropa has stocked up on water, medicines and emergency supplies and placed response teams on standby as the region prepares for the possible impact of El Niño. During a recent meeting of the Regional Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council, the DOH-MIMAROPA Center for Health Development reported that water, sanitation and hygiene supplies had been distributed across Oriental and Occidental Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon and Palawan, according to the Philippine Information Agency. The supplies include collapsible jerry cans and hygiene kits.
